item.title: McIntosh sentenced in animal cruelty case
item.description: EATON — A Camden man and former volunteer firefighter has been convicted and sentenced in Preble County Common Pleas Court on a felony charge of cruelty to companion animals in a case involving the starvation of a dog later rescued and rehabilitated, according to court records and a statement from the Preble County Humane Society. The post McIntosh sentenced in animal cruelty case appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Commissioners adopt assembly permit requirements
item.description: EATON — To kick off the new year, Preble County Commissioners on Monday, Jan. 5, adopted a resolution establishing a permit requirement for speeches, demonstrations, parades and other assemblies held at the Preble County Courthouse or on other county-owned property. The post Commissioners adopt assembly permit requirements appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: McIntire resigns, Maggard named Lanier fiscal officer
item.description: LANIER TOWNSHIP — The Lanier Township Board of Trustees met Dec. 29, 2025, for its final meeting of the year, during which trustees accepted the resignation of Fiscal Officer Mark McIntire and appointed his successor. The post McIntire resigns, Maggard named Lanier fiscal officer appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Picture this
item.description: Many families have that one person who winds up with the family memorabilia such as pictures, news articles, family Bibles, special dishes, and who knows what else. I never set out to be that guy, but over the course of the past ten years or so, it’s slowly happened to me. The post Picture this appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Local author releases 2nd bookon the Dayton & Union Railroad
item.description: BROOKVILLE — Following the success of his first book on the Dayton & Union Railroad, local historian Todd Clemmons has released a second volume that continues the story of one of our most important local rail lines.
